plugins.readme_text:
# Studio for DeepSeek Harness

Themes and personalisation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): 18 themes, a theme editor that builds themes from a mood, one colour, any word or any picture, a theme per workspace, a community gallery of themes and prompt packs, liquid-glass panels, wallpapers (Bing daily, slideshows and video), fonts, saved looks on a schedule that can follow sunrise and sunset, your Windows accent colour, layout controls and a focus mode, AI modes, task-finished alerts, a usage and cost dashboard with spending alerts, chat export to Markdown and PDF, accessibility options, smarter saved prompts, settings sync, a Ctrl+K quick switcher, and 19 languages.

Zero npm dependencies. Your settings stay on your machine unless you turn on sync.

![Studio with the Liquid Glass theme and frosted-glass panels](docs/screenshots/themes-dark.jpg)

| Liquid glass + personal greeting | Quick switcher (live preview) | Theme editor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![Frosted-glass composer over a wallpaper, greeting "Good night, RdotA"](docs/screenshots/greeting.jpg) | ![Ctrl+K quick switcher previewing Tokyo Night](docs/screenshots/quick-switcher.jpg) | ![Theme editor: moods, one colour, any word, with the Cyber mood previewed across the app](docs/screenshots/theme-editor.jpg) |

| Community gallery | Usage & cost (sample data) | Looks & schedule, in Japanese |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![Gallery tab with community themes and their authors](docs/screenshots/gallery.jpg) | ![Usage tab: totals, 30-day chart and per-model prices](docs/screenshots/usage.jpg) | ![Saved looks and a time-of-day schedule, interface in Japanese](docs/screenshots/looks-schedule-ja.jpg) |

| Prompts that ask first | Saved prompts | Light mode (Synthwave) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![A saved prompt asking for Topic and Audience before inserting](docs/screenshots/prompt-questions.jpg) | ![Saved prompts menu beside the composer](docs/screenshots/saved-prompts.jpg) | ![Studio themes page in light mode](docs/screenshots/themes-light.jpg) |

## Install

**From the app:** open DSH → sidebar **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → enter

```
github:IRdotAI/dsh-studio
```

**From a terminal:**

```
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:IRdotAI/dsh-studio
```

Then restart `dsh web`. A **Studio** entry appears in the sidebar. Requires DSH 0.2 (tested with 0.2.0-rc.2), the web profile, and Node 22.5+. `pnpm` must be on your PATH for plugin installs (`npm install -g pnpm`).

Already on 1.3 or later? Studio offers the update itself (**Studio → Updates**).

To remove it, use **Uninstall** on its Plugins page entry.

## Using it

- **Studio** in the sidebar has everything, in tabs. Pick your language in the top-right corner (**Automatic** follows your browser, or DSH itself when it's set to Chinese).
- **Ctrl+K** (Cmd+K on macOS) opens the quick switcher anywhere: themes (arrow through them to preview live; Esc puts yours back), your looks, AI modes, light/dark, text size, chat width, focus mode, ambience, saved prompts, alerts, chat export, backup, updates and every Studio page.
- In the composer, type **/theme**, **/ai**, **/transcript**, **/prompts**, **/focus** or **/studio**, or click the **✦** button beside the input for saved prompts.

## Features

| Area | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| **18 themes** | Liquid Glass, Midnight, Dracula, Nord, Tokyo Night, Catppuccin, Rosé Pine, Gruvbox, Solarized, Forest, Ocean, Synthwave, Sakura, Arc Reactor, Espresso, Paper, AMOLED and High Contrast, plus the stock look. Each has a light and a dark version, so DSH's Light / Dark / System switch keeps working. |
| **Theme per workspace** | Give any workspace its own theme or look, so you can tell your projects apart at a glance. It switches as you move between workspaces and goes back to your usual theme everywhere else. |
| **Theme editor** | Pick a background, text and accent colour per mode, plus an optional second accent for gradients. Studio derives every surface, border, button and text shade from them in OKLCH, with contrast floors so secondary text stays readable. Live contrast badges with one-click **Fix**, a screen colour picker 💧, any CSS colour (`rgb(…)`, `hsl(…)`, `tomato`), **undo/redo** (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y), **Make Light from Dark** (and back), a colour-blindness preview, whole-app preview while editing, shareable `dshs1:` codes and `.json` theme files. |
| **Make a theme** | Twelve **moods** (Calm, Cozy, Cyber, Sunset…, a new take every click), **one colour** with a colour-harmony rule (monochrome, analogous, complementary, split, triadic), **any word** (the same word always makes the same theme), or 🎲 Surprise me. **Lock** 🔒 the colours you like and generators keep them. **Fine-tune** sliders move the whole theme (hue, vividness, warmth, background), and **Variations** offers eight ready-made twists. Text always stays readable. |
| **Theme from an image** | Build a theme from your desktop wallpaper, your Studio wallpaper or any picture: Studio clusters its colours, picks a background tint and accents, and fits them for contrast in both modes. |
| **Community gallery** | **Studio → Gallery** lists themes and prompt packs shared by other users; one click adds a theme or a whole pack of prompts. **Submit to the gallery** in the theme editor, or on a prompt folder, opens GitHub with your file ready to propose. See [gallery/](gallery/). |
| **Looks & schedule** | Save your theme, style and wallpaper together as a named look, then switch whole setups in one click, or on a schedule: at a set time, or at **sunrise** and **sunset** where you are (e.g. a light theme at sunrise, Liquid Glass at sunset). Changing things yourself sticks until the next switch. |
| **Windows colours** | **Use my Windows accent colour** recolours the current theme's highlights to your Windows accent and follows it when you change it; **Follow Windows light/dark** switches with the system. |
| **Liquid glass** | Style → Material turns the sidebar, composer, cards, dialogs, message bubbles and menus into frosted, see-through panes: backdrop blur, a faint frost, a specular top edge and a diagonal sheen. DSH's own surfaces are found at runtime, so it keeps working across DSH updates. **Match my desktop** applies the whole look in one click. |
| **Layout** | Chat width (narrow to full), interface size (75–140 %), and **focus mode**, which folds the sidebar and side panel away. |
| **Wallpaper** | Upload an image or use a URL; (on Windows) **use your desktop wallpaper**, which follows wallpaper changes; **Bing daily**, a new picture every day; a **slideshow** from a folder of images, changing every few minutes to once a day; or a muted, looping **video** that pauses when the window is hidden. Adjustable visibility and blur. |
| **Style** | Interface and code fonts (presets, any installed font, or a folder of `.otf/.ttf/.woff2` files), corner style, accent-tinted chat bubbles, accent text selection, surface tint. |
| **Ambience** | Aurora glow, vignette, film grain or CRT scanlines, with a strength slider. Never blocks clicks; honours reduced motion. |
| **Identity** | Rename the app in the sidebar, swap the logo (emoji, monogram or your own image, removable with one click), and replace the new-chat headline with a greeting like `Good {timeOfDay}, {name}`, in your language. |
| **AI preferences** | Optional custom instructions: your name, about you, a response style (Concise, Thorough, Friendly, Mentor, Butler, Hype), reply language and free-form instructions. **Off by default**; the tab shows exactly what the model will receive. |
| **AI modes** | Saved sets of style, language and instructions: Coding, Writing, Explain simply and Brainstorm to start, plus any you save yourself. Switch with **/ai** in the composer, from Ctrl+K, or on the AI tab. |
| **Saved prompts** | Six starters; add, edit, reorder and file your own into folders. Placeholders fill themselves in when you insert: `{clipboard}`, `{date}`, `{time}`, `{day}`, and `{ask:Topic}`, which asks you first. Share all your prompts as one `dshp1:` pack code, add a pack from a code or file, or send a folder to the gallery. |
| *

plugins.description: STT support for DeepSeek Harness using local models from Cactus Compute and Desert Ant Labs
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-stt Multi-model local speech recognition for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web composer. A microphone appears between the model selector and Send. **Click once and start talking** — the recording ends on its own about a second after you stop speaking, and the transcript is inserted into the draft for review. **You choose which on-device model transcribes**, and nothing is downloaded until you choose it. The recognizer is loaded when you *start* recording, not when you finish, so the wait happens behind your own voice instead of after it. ## Models | Pick | Size | Languages | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | **Whistle** (Cactus Compute) | **18.4 MB** | 7, auto-detected | default; loads in 30 ms, ~116 MB RAM | | **Voz** (Desert Ant Labs) | ~390 MB | 25 | higher accuracy; ~1 GB RAM while warm | | SenseVoice | — | — | *coming soon* — advertised only, downloads nothing | Both working models were measured end-to-end on Windows and each transcribed a 7.62 s clip correctly: Whistle in 1.52 s using 116 MB, Voz in 2.39 s. ## Install This is a **rider** on the shipped voice bundle: that bundle supplies the microphone UI and the speech service, and this package adds the models. Install both, **in this order** — layers apply in list order and a later layer wins for a given row id: ```sh # The voice-bundle version MATTERS: plain `add` resolves the npm `latest` tag # (0.1.7-alpha.1), which does not match a DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 runtime. Pin yours. dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add @try-works/dsh-stt ``` Installing from a checkout instead of the registry works the same way: `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-stt`. Then open **Settings → Plugins → Voice Input** and pick a model. The picker lists every model with its size and time estimate; **Download and prepare** fetches only the one you selected. ## Configuration `cordis.patch.yml` carries the whole configuration. Each model is a key under `providers`: ```yaml providers: whistle-local: enabled: true voz-local: enabled: false # keep 390 MB out of the picker entirely sensevoice-local: enabled: true # placeholder only ``` | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `enabled` | `false` stops the provider registering — it is never listed, selected or downloaded | | `modelRoot` | where that model's files live; defaults to `/` | | `id` | override the provider id (advanced; the selection is stored by id) | | `name` | override the display name shown in the picker | `dataRoot` is required and must be an absolute path. ## How the recording ends A silence gate watches the microphone level. Nothing stops until it has heard **300 ms of speech**, so a cough or a door cannot end a recording before you have said anything; after that, **1.2 s of quiet** ends it. The Stop button is still there, and Escape or switching away cancels and discards. Because this needs the microphone level, the plugin ships its own browser half and registers it into the composer slot at a lower priority than the shipped microphone, which therefore stops rendering. That is also why the wait disappears: the same half asks the host to load the model the moment recording starts. ## Architecture ``` src/index.js register every enabled provider src/config.js schemastery configuration src/provider-kit/ http.js resumable download (see below) preparation.js disk inspection + the state the UI renders oneshot.js one process per recording worker.js one warm process, idle-reclaimed src/providers/whistle/ one-shot: needle.exe per recording src/providers/voz/ warm worker holding the model src/providers/sensevoice/ placeholder: advertises, never downloads ``` ### Two deliberate engine strategies Whistle runs **one process per recording**. Its engine loads the 16.9 MB model in ~30 ms, so paying that per request buys real crash isolation and automatic memory reclamation. It also satisfies the engine's *one process-global model per kind* rule for free. Voz runs as a **warm worker** because its load costs 6.2 s and about a gigabyte; the child persists between recordings and is released after five idle minutes. ### Why we download the models ourselves `Voz.load()` fetches its 384,832,967 bytes with a single `fetch` per file and **no retry, no resume and no timeout**. On a real connection that failed at 37.5% of the largest file, and a resumable retry hit three more drops. Preparation therefore pre-populates Voz's cache with a resumable `Range` download, after which `Voz.load({ cache: true })` adopts the files without fetching. ## Limitations - **Insert, not send.** The transcript lands in the draft; you press Enter. No message is ever sent on your behalf. - **The microphone UI is the shipped one.** This package contributes providers only, because the picker is keyed to the shipped voice bundle's detail page. - **SenseVoice is advertised, not delivered.** Its entry cannot be downloaded; see the hand-over note in `src/providers/sensevoice/index.js`. - **Recording limits** are the seam's defaults: 4 MB and 120 s per recording. Whistle's engine accepts only 30 s per call, so a longer recording is cut at the quietest nearby moment and transcribed in segments that are joined in order. Nothing to configure; 45 s of speech costs roughly 12 s of inference. - Local means *the Host machine*, which may be remote from your browser.

plugins.description: DSH注入系统提示词和设置注入上下文插件。内置吃白饭的蓝色大肥鱼拟人鲸鱼娘女仆角色扮演设定！
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-persona-select · 人设管理与人设注入 > DSH 插件：把人设正文注入**系统提示词**，把历史对话注入**上下文**。设置页的人设管理负责保存与编辑，对话模式选择行下方可以随时切换人设。 > > Bilingual README. [中文](#中文) · [English](#english) --- --- ## 中文 ### 这个插件做什么 它负责两件事：把一段文字送进**系统提示词**，把一段对话送进**上下文**。为了说清楚，本文与插件设置界面统一使用两个叫法： | 叫法 | 指的是 | | --- | --- | | **人设正文** | 注入系统提示词的那段内容 | | **历史对话** | 作为上下文注入的一段"已经发生过"的对话 | 两者按**人设**成对保存：在设置页把人设正文和历史对话写好、存成一条预设「人设」，之后在对话里选中这条人设，两者按各自的规则进入这一次请求。 ### 注入的规则 **人设正文**进入系统提示词的**人设段**，**注入位置可自行编辑**：「段序权重」决定这一段排在系统提示词的哪个位置。 - **数值**：按权重大小排序，**数字越小越靠前**（默认 `-1`，排在预设里那句 "You are a coding agent…" 之前）。 - **追随**：点「追随」后，人设段被放到**所有系统提示词段之后**。 - 权重只影响排序，**永远不会混进人设正文**；每条人设各自保存自己的权重，编辑框跟着当前选中的那条人设走。 - 必须填整数（`-1000000000` ~ `1000000000`）：小数、指数、带单位都会被拒绝保存。 **历史对话**在**新对话的第一步**作为 user 侧上下文注入一次，并按仿照 DSH 自身注入的格式包裹： - 整段包进一对 ``，开口之后是 `CONTEXT_ROAD:`，结尾是 `CONTINUE_CONTEXT.`；正文里出现的收尾标签会被转义，保证壳子不会被提前闭合。 - 往期对话的 user 侧内容包在 `` 里；模型侧的思考包在 `` 里、说的话包在 `` 里；双方非对话内容包在 `` 之类的标记里；压缩摘要保持 `…` 原样。 **已经注入过的对话不会重复注入**（那会把整段对话的缓存读取推倒重来）。所以历史对话只在每个新对话的第一步生效；如果想让一个已经聊起来的对话也带上历史，只能把历史写进人设正文——但效果不好，不推荐。 ### 人设管理 - 新建、编辑、保存、删除人设，**复制为新人设**（内置人设只读，要改就复制一份副本再改）。 - 每一条人设包含：名称、人设正文、段序权重、历史对话。 - **设置分开保存**：每个对话保存自己的选择与开关，**切换人设、改动勾选项都不会影响新对话和进行中的对话**。设置页有「当前 / 全局」两个页签，分别对应"这一个对话"和"新对话默认跟随的设置"。 - 保存前会先校验：正文为空、名称为空、权重不是整数都会拒绝保存并说明原因；正文超过建议上限会提示但完整保留。 - 未保存的改动在切换人设时会先询问，避免默默丢掉。 ### 屏蔽与「纯聊天」 四个开关各自撤掉一类模型本来能看到的**系统侧输入**： | 开关 | 撤掉什么 | | --- | --- | | **只留人设** | 系统提示词里除人设段以外的所有段：harness 身份、部署人设、工具指引、计划模式策略、harness 源码说明。人设为空时，系统提示词就是空的。 | | **屏蔽 runtime 上下文** | 两类：① 沙箱策略、审批策略、委派规则等以 user 角色快照下发的动态上下文；② 包在 `` 里的 runtime 快照与 skill 目录。 | | **屏蔽 schema 工具** | 工具定义（它走独立的协议字段，不是系统提示词段，通常是最大的一笔 token）。打开后模型没有可调用的工具。 | | **屏蔽其他注入内容** | AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 之类的指令基线与逐步时间读数——它们同样是以 user 角色消息追加进来的，只能按来源过滤。 | 四个开关全开、且没有选中人设，就是**纯聊天**：系统侧注入归零，模型只看到你发的内容。对话界面的选择框里有「一键纯聊天 / 恢复系统输入」按钮直接切换这两个状态。 **工具保活通道**（「可复用工具」）：屏蔽 schema 工具的保险丝。DSH 的工具账本要求每个对话有一份非空的工具声明基线，基线一旦被清空，回来的工具都会被打上 deferred 标记并被服务方以 `INVALID_REQUEST` 拒绝。勾上它，插件只在**两个时刻**保留完整工具列表各一轮——这个对话的**第一次请求**，以及**疑似声明序列重启**（例如压缩）时——先让基线建立起来，之后无论怎么开关屏蔽，工具都还能回来。 以下为关闭所有系统测注入后，你能够真实达到的token消耗 ### 导入与导出 **导出**（设置页编辑器里那条人设的正文 + 段序权重 + 历史对话一起走）： - **导出 JSON**：纯 JSON，不压缩、不丢信息。 - **导出图片**：由**你自己挑一张 PNG 当封面**，同样的数据打进图片里一起作为一张角色卡下载。图片本身的数据一个字节都不改，包括AI生图或捏人游戏角色卡(导出为png格式的游戏，例如恋活)，任何看图软件照常显示它。 - 单次导出上限 32 MB；选了非 PNG、或 PNG 结构不完整（读不出 IHDR）会被直接拒绝并说明原因。 - 导出取的是编辑器里那条人设**已保存**的版本：有未保存改动会先询问，新建但还没保存的人设不能导出。 **导入**： - 读本插件导出的 `.json`，或「导出图片」生成的那张 `.png`，作为**新人设追加**进列表——**绝不覆盖已有条目**。 - **直接导入 DSH 自己 `/export` 出来的 Session 日志**：接受 `/export` 产生的 `.zip`，也接受裸的 `session.vN.jsonl` / `session.jsonl`，以及 `.jsonl.zstd` / `.zst`。导入时两个独立开关： - **导入思考过程**：决定模型侧的 `` 跟不跟着进来。 - **展开压缩**：默认只取压缩摘要 `` 与**最后一次摘要之后**的对话；勾上后反过来——取**除摘要之外**的全部内容，把压缩展开回原文。历史从未压缩过时，这个勾选项不改变任何东西。 ### 对话界面的选择框 对话模式选择行下方那个「人设」展开： - 切换当前对话的人设，或选「不注入」。 - **一键纯聊天 / 恢复系统输入**。 - 层徽标告诉你这条设置是**本对话**的还是**全局**的。 - 状态点： - 绿点：工具基线可用，一切正常。 - 黄点：本对话选定人设的历史对话与当初注入的那份对不上了；本对话的人设正文没进系统提示词（例如对话用了声明 `complete: true` 的「极简模式」）；本对话已经聊过，所以这条人设的历史对话不再注入；或「可复用工具」没勾。 - 红点：本对话选的人设已被删除（人设段现在是空的），或这个对话的首次请求没带任何工具（工具基线为空，本对话内工具回不来）。 - 设置页的「当前」页会按来源列出**这个对话里被过滤掉**的注入块：runtime 快照、skill 目录、工作区指令、时间读数。 ### 数据文件 `/persona-select/`（`DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`）： | 文件 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `personas.json` | 全局设置、人设列表、每个对话的选择与开关 | | `personas.json.v2-backup` | 旧版升级时的备份，可删 | | `history/<编号>.txt` | 各条人设的历史对话正文 | - 名称最长 40 字；人设正文建议不超过 20000 字（超过会提示，但完整保留、不截断）；最多 200 条人设；最多保留 500 条对话记录。 - 会话记录会被自动清理：已经不存在、也不在活动列表里的对话记录会被回收（设置页也可主动触发），避免文件无限膨胀。 ### 界面 设置页与对话界面均跟随宿主语言，内置中文 / English 两套文案。 ### 内置人设声明 插件中“鲸鱼娘”的形象描述来自[@ZipZipPipe](https://space.bilibili.com/4168597)，遵守CC BY-NC-SA 4.0协议再创作并开源，请尊重相关形象创造者。 --- ## English ### What this plugin does Two jobs: put a block of text into the **system prompt**, and put a stretch of conversation into the **context**. To keep the wording precise, this README uses the same two names as the plugin UI: | Term | Meaning | | --- | --- | | **Persona text** | the content injected into the system prompt | | **Conversation history** | a stretch of "already happened" dialogue injected as context | The two are stored together as one **persona**: write the text and the history in the settings page, save them as a persona preset, then pick that persona in a conversation and both enter the request by their own rules. ### How injection works **Persona text** becomes the **persona section** of the system prompt, and **its position is yours to edit**: the "Section order weight" decides where that section sits. - **A number**: sections sort by weight, **lower comes first** (default `-1`, ahead of the preset line "You are a coding agent…"). - **Follow**: click it and the persona section is appended **after every system-prompt section**. - The weight only affects ordering and **never enters the persona text**. Each persona keeps its own weight, and the field follows whichever persona you are editing. - It must be an integer (`-1000000000` to `1000000000`): decimals, exponents and units are refused on save. **Conversation history** is injected once, as user-side context, at the **first step of a new conversation**, wrapped in a shell that imitates how DSH itself injects context: - the whole block sits inside one `` pair, opened by `CONTEXT_ROAD:` and closed by `CONTINUE_CONTEXT.`; any closing tag occurring in the body is escaped so the shell can never be closed early. - inside it, past user-side content goes inside ``; the model side's thinking goes inside ``, its spoken content inside ``; non-conversational content from either side (tool calls, multimodal parts) goes inside markers such as ``; compaction summaries stay wrapped in `…`, verbatim. **A conversation that has already been injected is never injected again** — doing so would tear down the whole conversation's cached input(KV cache). History therefore only takes effect on the first step of each new conversation. If an already-running conversation must carry history across a persona switch, you can write that history into the persona text itself — the result is poor, so it is not recommended. ### Managing personas - Create, edit, save and delete personas, and **fork as new** (built-in personas are read-only; fork a copy to edit one). - Each persona carries: name, persona text, section order weight, conversation history. - **Settings are saved per conversation**: each conversation keeps its own selection and switches, so **switching personas or toggling a switch never affects new conversations or conversations in progress**. The settings page has a Current / Global tab pair — "this conversation" versus "what new conversations follow". - Saving validates first: empty text, empty name or a non-integer weight is refused with a reason; text over the recommended limit is reported but kept in full. - Unsaved edits trigger a confirmation before switching personas, so nothing is silently dropped. ### Suppression and pure chat Four switches, each removing one class of system-side input the model would otherwise see: | Switch | What it removes | | --- | --- | | **Persona only** | Every system-prompt section except the persona: harness identity, deployment persona, tool guidance, plan-mode policy, harness-source notes. With no persona selected the system prompt is empty. | | **Suppress runtime context** | Two families: (1) sandbox policy, approval policy and delegation rules delivered as user-role snapshots; (2) the runtime snapshot and skill catalog framed as `` blocks. | | **Suppress tool schemas** | Tool definitions (a separate wire field, not a prompt section, and usually the biggest token item). With this on the model has nothing t

plugins.readme_text:
# 鲸鲸桌宠 · WhalePet

一只住在 Windows 桌面上的蓝色鲸鱼女仆。用 PySide6 写的桌宠：会待机、会眨眼、会饿、
会记账，接得上大模型 API 陪聊，也能通过飞书远程使唤她。

![鲸鲸](assets/01_front.png)

当前版本 **v1.0.1**（分享版 · 单形态）。不想装 Python？到
[Releases](../../releases) 页面下载打包好的 exe。

## 它是什么

一个纯 Python + Qt 的桌面宠物，没有游戏引擎、没有前端框架。窗口是透明无边框的置顶
窗口，角色靠逐帧换图做动画（待机呼吸、眨眼、睡觉、进食），呆毛和尾巴是拆出来单独摆动的
部件。除此之外还接了几条实用的通道：大模型聊天、余额记账、飞书收发消息、任务派发。

## 功能

**桌宠本体**

- 透明无边框置顶窗口，可拖动、可调大小（设置里一个滑块，默认 340 px 高）
- 待机呼吸、眨眼（5 帧）、睡觉、吃饭等多套动画；呆毛与尾巴独立摆动
- 16 张表情图：开心、害羞、生气、困、惊讶、爱、得意、委屈、想哭、无语……
- 台词气泡自动排版，不溢出屏幕；字号可调（9~28 px，默认 13）

**交互与界面**

- 右键菜单：和鲸鲸说句话 / 小鲸鱼记账 / 查看提醒 / 显示时钟 / 派活给 Harness /
  做个表情 / 去睡觉 / 回到待机 / 设置… / 隐藏
- 两模式窗口：**聊天模式** ↔ **工作模式**，一键切换
- 工作模式左栏列出任务会话，自动区分主任务与子任务（子任务默认折叠、右键展开）
- 设置窗口 5 页：聊天与钥匙 / 飞书接入 / 音效 / 桌宠 / 关于

**能力通道**

- **大模型聊天**：填自己的 API key 即可，内置 DeepSeek / 通义千问 / 智谱 / Moonshot /
  OpenAI / 本地 Ollama 六套预设，回答支持 Markdown 渲染（含表格）
- **小鲸鱼记账**：靠余额观测推算今日已用，自动判断峰谷时段
  （周一至周五 9–12、14–18 为峰，其余含节假日全谷）
- **提醒与时钟**：长期 / 短期提醒 + 桌面时钟
- **飞书接入**：手机发文字或图片给她，桌宠会存盘并回话；发 `/shot` 可以把当前屏幕截图发回手机
- **音效**：6 个 wav 由 `make_sounds.py` 用纯标准库现场合成，不依赖任何第三方音频素材
- **单实例保护**：同时只允许一只桌宠进程，第二次双击等于把已有那只叫到前台

## 快速开始

### 方式一：跑源码

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python whale_pet.py
```

### 方式二：下载 exe

到 [Releases](../../releases) 下载 `WhalePet_share_*.zip`，解压后双击
`WhalePet_onedir\WhalePet.exe`。免安装，不需要 Python 环境。

> 压缩包里**只有可执行文件与 LICENSE**（约 71 MiB）。想要源码或自己改，直接 clone 本仓库。

### 自检与体检

改完代码建议先跑这两条：

```bash
python whale_pet.py --selftest              # 自检，退出码 0 表示通过
python whale_pet.py --selftest --selftest-log 自检.log
python whale_pet.py --doctor                # 体检：API / 飞书 / DSH 通道逐项真测
python whale_pet.py --version
```

## 重新打包 exe

```bash
pip install pyinstaller
python -m PyInstaller WhalePet_onedir.spec
```

产物在 `dist/WhalePet_onedir/`。（单文件版用 `WhalePet.spec`。）

## 目录结构

```
whale_pet.py           入口，python whale_pet.py 就能起
pet_constants.py       常量与默认配置（版本号 APP_VERSION 的唯一来源）
pet_shell.py           主窗口与整体装配
pet_mixin_*.py         UI / 聊天 / 动画 / 生命值 / 通道接入 五组 Mixin
pet_panels.py          各类面板（记账、提醒、时钟…）
pet_settings.py        设置窗口外壳（外壳 + 页面工厂）
pet_bridges.py         外部通道桥接
pet_feishu.py          飞书自实现协议（长连接收发）
pet_remote.py          远程控制 HTTP 服务
pet_doctor.py          体检（--doctor）
pet_selftest.py        自检（--selftest）
pet_store.py           配置与状态落盘
pet_ledger.py          记账
pet_sound.py           音效播放
dsh_*.py               DeepSeek Harness 接入
make_sounds.py         合成 6 个音效 wav
test_*.py              回归测试
assets/                立绘、表情、眨眼、睡姿、呆毛、尾巴、饭碗 + 音效
WhalePet*.spec         PyInstaller 打包配置（单文件 / onedir）
requirements.txt       依赖
```

## 关于密钥与隐私

**这个仓库里不含任何密钥。** API key、飞书 App ID / App Secret 只存在你自己机器上的
`whale_pet_config.json`（程序首次运行会生成），该文件以及运行状态、聊天记录、记忆、记账
本等个人数据全部已在 `.gitignore` 中排除。

## 环境要求

- **Windows 10 / 11** —— 大量使用 win32 API（置顶层级、托盘、窗口穿透），不跨平台
- **Python 3.10+**（开发环境为 3.13）
- `PySide6 >= 6.5`、`zstandard >= 0.21`、`websockets >= 11.0`

打包另需 `pyinstaller >= 6.0`、`pywin32 >= 306`。

## 已知限制

- 仅支持 Windows 10 / 11，没有 macOS / Linux 版本
- DSH（DeepSeek Harness）默认从「当前用户的标准安装位置」查找；装在别处时可用环境变量
  `DSH_APP_DIR` 指定，或在配置里填 `dsh_exe`
- 分享版是单形态版本（只有全身女仆装一种形态，无「切换形态」功能），且不含局域网远程控制

## License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-compat-plus **一条命令，让你 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 里的技能在 dsh 原地复活。** 零迁移 · 只读挂载 · 改完即生效 · 模型自动用、用户随手 `/` 社区插件生态：[awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-skill-compat-plus)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-skill-compat-plus) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A524-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%E2%89%A50.2.0--rc.2-4176E6.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-32%20passing-2EA44F.svg)](#本地开发) [![audit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mimosa%20audit-clean-2EA44F.svg)](#安全)
你在 Claude Code 里攒了一堆 skills，Codex 和 ZCode 里又各有一套——切到 [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，一个都带不过去，只能逐个复制 `SKILL.md` 再手动同步。**本插件把这三家的技能目录作为只读技能来源直接挂进 dsh**：技能原地不动，模型按需自动加载，用户敲 `/名字` 随手调用，文件一改秒级生效。 > [!TIP] > ## Quick Start > > CLI（推荐带版本号，规避 profile 安装端的 `minimumReleaseAge` 冷却）： > > ```bash > dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-skill-compat-plus@0.1.0 > ``` > > 桌面端：**插件页搜索 `dsh-skill-compat-plus` 一键安装**，装完重启。装完什么都不用配——三家来源默认全开，目录不存在自动跳过。 ## 效果一览（示意） ```text 用户敲 / ────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 4drawio 数学建模非数据型图示绘制阶段… │ │ nature-figure Create, revise, audit, and … │ │ 1start-mathmodel 数学建模竞赛工作流入口。用于启动… │ │ …（本机实测：Claude 30 个 + Codex 20 个一次到位） │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ 模型侧：同一批技能进入 skill 工具的 目录，按需自动加载。 ``` ## 为什么是"挂"而不是"搬" - **原地不动**。技能文件留在原目录，不复制、不改写、卸载即恢复原状——对齐 modlens 的"一个插件、零侵入"哲学。 - **双侧可用**。`user-invocable` 技能自动获得 dsh 原生 `/名字` 手势入口（host 端 pre-step 解析，无需注册命令）；模型侧进入 catalog 按需加载。 - **热更新**。chokidar 监听 + 存在性轮询双通道：目录里增删改技能、甚至整个目录后建，都不用重启。 - **名称规范化**。`_references` → `references`、`code_review` → `code-review` 自动 slug 化；Claude 缺省的 description 从正文首段合成——dsh 的两条硬约束（kebab 名 + 非空描述）由插件兜底。 - **优先级刻死**。dsh 原生技能永远坐 C 位，同名导入技能让位；项目级导入压过用户级导入。不会出现导入悄悄覆盖原生的情况。 - **诊断不刷屏**。无效文件、命名冲突按"问题集合变化"输出 warn， catalog 重建再多次也只有变化时说一句。 ## 支持的来源 | 来源 | 目录 | 默认 | |---|---|---| | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/skills` + `<项目根>/.claude/skills` | 开 | | `codex` | `~/.codex/skills`（旧约定；新官方 `~/.agents/skills` dsh 原生已扫） | 开 | | `zcode` | `~/.zcode/skills` + `<项目根>/.zcode/skills` | 开 | | `extraDirs` | 任意额外目录（`{ path, label?, rank? }`） | 空 | 目录不存在静默跳过；每家可单独开关、自定义路径与 rank。 ## 字段映射（外来 frontmatter → dsh） | 外来字段 | 映射 | |---|---| | `name` | 缺省取目录名；不合 dsh kebab 规则 → slug 化（可关） | | `description` | 缺失（Claude 允许）→ 正文首段合成（可关） | | `when_to_use` / `whenToUse` | → `whenToUse` | | `disable-model-invocation` | → `invocation.modelInvocable: false` | | `user-invocable` | → `invocation.userInvocable` | | Codex `agents/openai.yaml` 的 `policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false` | → `invocation.modelInvocable: false` | | `allowed-tools` / `model` / `hooks` / `license` / `compatibility` 等 | 原样保留进 `metadata`（dsh 无对应物，不静默丢弃） | 整个原始 frontmatter 全量保真进 `metadata`，可追溯。
完整优先级表（rank，越小越优先） | 来源 | 目录 | rank | |---|---|---| | dsh 原生 project-dsh | `<项目根>/.dsh/skills` | 100 | | dsh 原生 project-agents | `<项目根>/.agents/skills` | 200 | | **claude-code 项目级** | `<项目根>/.claude/skills` | **210** | | **zcode 项目级** | `<项目根>/.zcode/skills` | **220** | | dsh 原生 custom / **extraDirs** | 配置目录 | 300 | | dsh 原生 user-dsh | `~/.dsh/skills` | 400 | | **claude-code 用户级** | `~/.claude/skills` | **450** | | **codex 用户级** | `~/.codex/skills` | **460** | | **zcode 用户级** | `~/.zcode/skills` | **470** | | dsh 原生 user-agents / bundled | `~/.agents/skills` / 内置 | 500 / 600 | 同名裁决由 dsh 官方注册表完成（rank → provider 注册序 → list 内顺序），本插件保证 rank 确定且原生恒优先。
## 配置 写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 entry `config` 下（profile 层可覆盖，整体替换语义），未知键 fail-fast： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `providerName` | `skill-compat-plus` | provider 注册名（`runtime` 为保留字） | | `sources.claude` / `.codex` / `.zcode` | `true` | `boolean` 或 `{ enabled?, project?, root?, rank? }` | | `extraDirs` | `[]` | `{ path, label?, rank? }[]` | | `watch` | `true` | 热更新开关 | | `watchUsePolling` | `false` | 网络盘/特殊文件系统开启 | | `watchStabilityThresholdMs` / `watchPollIntervalMs` | 200 / 100 | awaitWriteFinish 参数 | | `watchMaxProjects` | `128` | 项目根监视 LRU 上限 | | `slugifyNames` | `true` | 关闭后不合规名直接 skip | | `synthesizeDescription` | `true` | 关闭后缺 description 的技能直接 skip | > [!NOTE] > 导入技能会进入每个会话的 `` 目录提醒，挂太多会持续占用模型上下文——建议用 `sources.*.enabled` / `extraDirs` 按需精选。 ## 安装方式 | 方式 | 命令 / 操作 | |---|---| | CLI（npm 包） | `dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-skill-compat-plus@0.1.0` | | 桌面端 | 插件页搜索安装；或 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "/d/DeepSeek Harness/DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals "D:/DeepSeek Harness/resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host/lib/cli.js" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-skill-compat-plus`（Git Bash，先完全退出应用含托盘） | | git 直装（始终最新 main） | `dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add git+https://github.com/shuxidemosheng/dsh-skill-compat-plus.git` | | 本地 tgz | `npm pack` 后 `dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add file:<你的打包路径>/dsh-skill-compat-plus-0.1.0.tgz` | ## 已知限制 - Claude/ZCode **插件包内部**的技能（plugin cache、`.claude-plugin` 等）不在默认发现范围，可用 `extraDirs` 手动挂载；自动识别留待后续版本。 - 项目级只扫最近 `.git` 祖先**一级**（对齐 dsh 官方）；ZCode 式 CWD→worktree 多级扫描不做。 - Claude 的嵌套 `/.claude/skills`、`--add-dir`、企业托管目录不支持。 - `allowed-tools` / `model` / `hooks` 等执行语义字段仅保留在 `metadata`，dsh 侧无执行效果。 ## FAQ **Q: 会不会覆盖 dsh 原生技能？** 不会。同名时原生恒优先（见优先级表），本插件发现的重名会输出 `duplicate skill name` 诊断。 **Q: `~/.agents/skills` 里的技能怎么没被列出？** 那本来就是 dsh 原生扫描目录（同时也是 Codex 新官方用户根），无需桥接。 **Q: 技能文件改了没生效？** 确认 `watch: true`；网络盘开 `watchUsePolling: true`。存在性轮询约 2.5s，内容事件走 chokidar（亚秒级）。 ## 本地开发 ```bash npm install npm test # vitest，32 个用例（含 Windows 路径、真实时序 watch、上游文法对拍） npm run build # tsc d.ts + esbuild bundle（yaml/chokidar 为外部运行时依赖） node scripts/smoke.mjs # 构建产物直接扫描本机真实技能目录并打印清单 ``` ## 安全 - 只读挂载：唯一的系统写入是 watcher 句柄；技能内容由 dsh 官方 `skill` 管线加载，本插件不执行技能内代码。 - 产物只含第一方代码（`yaml`/`chokidar` 为运行时依赖），扫描面与攻击面最小化。 - Mimosa 深度扫描（2026-10-11，v0.1.0）：scanId `scan-2026-10-11T11-54-46.891Z-47166d49d84b`，seal `sha256:c5a95c8ed6f9b2079af39ecb487126b7814a52e362212f4104b3ae137a58cd57`，findings 0，依赖风险 0。历史：自包含产物曾报 6 条上游闭包静态误报（scanId `...3a00d7a1835b`），改外部依赖后归零。 ## 同类与致谢 - [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) —— SkillProvider 接缝、`dsh-skill-filesystem` 参考实现、bundle 机制 - 格式规范：[Claude Code skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) · [Codex skills](https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills) · [Agent Skills 开放规范](https://agentskills.io) - 同类项目：[YTyangtao666/dsh-skills-bridge](https://github.com/YTyangtao666/dsh-skills-bridge)（首发思路）——本插件在其之上补齐了目录覆盖面（三家来源 + 项目级）、标准 YAML 解析、slug 化与 description 合成、Windows 路径正确性、诊断聚合与 32 个单测 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Oh My DSH Chs - unofficial Simplified-Chinese fork of the tri-agent preset (Atlas orchestration + Prometheus planning), packaged for DeepSeek Harness. Content licensed under the upstream SUL-1.0; see NOTICE.md.
plugins.readme_text:
# oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs)
[![license: SUL-1.0 (content) + MIT (packaging)](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-SUL--1.0_(content)_%2B_MIT_(packaging)-orange)](#license)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19.0%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24.0.0-blue)](#peer-model)

The **Simplified-Chinese unofficial fork** of the `tri-agent` agent preset, packaged for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) as a publishable Cordis
bundle. Its preset id is `omo-fork-chs` and its `order` is `11`, so it sits beside `tri-agent`
rather than replacing it: this package **does not change the default preset** and does not change
which preset a session picks. Only the persona prose is translated; the toolchain composition and
the orchestration doctrine are the upstream design.

The preset gives an agent a two-mode identity and a full coding toolchain:

- **Atlas** is the standing orchestrator. It does not implement, verify, or review; it reads the
  plan, the notepad and the evidence, does the bookkeeping, and delegates every unit of work to a
  named subagent.
- **Prometheus** is the planning doctrine. While a session is in plan mode (`/plan`), the identity
  swaps to Prometheus for the whole planning session and then swaps back. A single plugin,
  `plan-aware-persona.mjs`, owns the one `deployment:persona-prefix` slot and chooses the text per
  assembly by reading the public `plan` session projection. The `planMode` service is deliberately
  not injected: it lives inside the `isolate: { planMode: true }` realm, so injecting it from
  outside would never resolve.

Around that identity the preset mounts the coding toolchain: filesystem and shell tools, background
jobs, skills, goals, plan mode, compaction, delegation and workflows. The declaration carries 40
`- id:` rows, of which 9 are anchored subagent rows (explore, librarian, oracle, momus,
multimodal-looker, sisyphus-junior, metis, hephaestus, sisyphus). The package ships **11 persona
files**; the plugin reads `atlas.md` and `prometheus.md` itself, and the other 9 are anchored to the
subagent rows.

## What ships

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The published bundle patch: the preset declaration (`id: preset-omo-fork-chs`, `config.id: omo-fork-chs`, `config.name: 'Oh My DSH Chs - OMO Fork'`, `order: 11`) and its `plugins:` list. 540 lines, 11 rewritten sites. |
| `plan-aware-persona.mjs` | The package entry that registers the plan-aware persona prefix and the configured suffix. Exported as `./persona`. |
| `index.js` | The package root. It is intentionally empty: the bundle's behaviour lives in `cordis.patch.yml` and in `./persona`. |
| `personas/` | 11 persona documents, translated into Simplified Chinese. |
| `baseline/` | A frozen snapshot of the pre-port patch plus a sidecar that explains what it does and does not prove. |
| `tools/` | The port, verification, baseline and package-check CLIs. |
| `test/` | The zero-dependency test suite, run with `node --test`. |
| `LICENSE-MIT.md` | The MIT terms that cover our own work. |
| `LICENSE-SUL-1.0.md` | The verbatim upstream Sustainable Use License 1.0 terms, which cover the upstream-derived content. |
| `NOTICE.md` | The modification notice, the upstream attribution, and the machine-readable license scope mapping. |

The patch mounts the following peer packages, which DSH provides:

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`, `dsh-agent-instructions`, `dsh-tool-bash`, `dsh-tool-pwsh`,
`dsh-tool-fs`, `dsh-tool-fs-search`, `dsh-tool-jobs`, `dsh-skill-filesystem`, `dsh-tool-skill`,
`dsh-command-goal`, `dsh-tool-goal`, `dsh-plan-mode`, `dsh-compaction-basic`, `dsh-command-compact`,
`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner`, `dsh-tool-subagent-control`, `dsh-tool-subagent`,
`dsh-workflow-ptc`, `dsh-tool-workflow`, `dsh-tool-ralph`, `dsh-tool-ask-user`, `dsh-tool-todo`,
`dsh-tool-web`, `dsh-tool-present`, plus `@deepseek-ai/cordis`. That is 25 peer dependencies in
total.

## Install

Installation is **two explicit steps**. Step 1 installs the dependency; step 2 tells the profile to
load it. Both are required, and `dsh` is not assumed to be on your `PATH`.

### Step 1: install the package into the profile

Point the CLI at your DSH checkout's bin file, and forward the install to the profile:

```powershell
node "<dsh bin>" plugin --profile <profile> add -w @tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs
```

For example, on a checkout whose runtime is `<dsh runtime>`, `<dsh bin>` is
`<dsh runtime>\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js`, so:

```powershell
node "<dsh runtime>\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js" plugin --profile web add -w @tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs
```

This runs pnpm inside `$DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\`, so it writes a `dependencies` entry. **It
does not touch `dsh.profile.bundles`.**

### Step 2: add the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart

Open `$DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>\package.json` and add the package name to the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles` array:

```jsonc
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        // ...your existing bundles...
        "@tacrine_f/oh-my-dsh-omo-fork-chs"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Then **restart the Host and start a new session.** A live agent keeps the composition it booted
with, so an already-running session will not pick the preset up; a new session is required.

### Verify the install composed

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "<dsh home>"
node "<dsh bin>" --profile <profile> --dump-config
```

The output should contain a `preset-omo-fork-chs` row whose `name` is
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`, whose `config.id` is `omo-fork-chs`, whose `config.name` is
`'Oh My DSH Chs - OMO Fork'` and whose `config.order` is `11`, plus nine `personas` expressions
resolving through this package. `--dump-config` prints the raw `!!js` expression text, so the nine
anchors appear as the `resolve('<pkg>/package.json')` form rather than as resolved filesystem
paths.

## Post-install edits you may need

The published patch ships **only** the portable preset declaration. Two things that were local to
the machine this fork came from are deliberately **not** shipped, so you may want to re-add them
yourself:

1. **Making `omo-fork-chs` your default preset.** The published patch does **not** set a default
   preset, and this package never forces one. If you want this preset to be the default, set the
   registry row yourself in your own profile or overlay patch:

   ```yaml
   - id: agent-preset-registry
     config:
       default: omo-fork-chs
   ```

   (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` inserts that row with `default: standard`; the row above replaces the
   whole config, so only the default changes.)

2. **Giving `subagent_multimodal_looker` a model route.** The bundle this fork was derived from
   carried a machine-specific `provider` and `model` route for that row, and that route is **not
   portable**, so the published patch carries no `agentOptions` row at all. Without one the
   multimodal subagent inherits the deployment's route. To pin one, add an `agentOptions` block to
   that row in your own overlay:

   ```yaml
   - id: tool-subagent-multimodal-looker
     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
     config:
       # ...the shipped config...
       agentOptions:
         provider: <your provider>
         model: <your model>
   ```

## Failure mode: it fails loud on purpose

`plan-aware-persona.mjs` reads its persona prose from disk at mount time. A **missing or empty
persona file fails the mount**, naming the file in the error:

```
plan-aware-persona: cannot read persona "file:///.../personas/atlas.md"
plan-aware-persona: persona "file:///.../personas/atlas.md" is empty
```

That is deliberate. An empty persona prefix would silently strip the agent's identity, so a mount
error that names the file is far easier to act on than an agent that quietly lost its instructions.

## Peer model

Every `@deepseek-ai/*` package the patch mounts is declared as a **`peerDependency`**, never as a
regular `dependency`. DSH provides them; the bundle must not install its own

plugins.readme_text:
# ZY-Agents ZY-Agents 是单租户自托管的企业级多智能体平台，采用**管理面与执行面分离**的架构：主服务负责认证、编排与数据，内核宿主负责 Agent 运行时与本地工具执行。 ## 架构概览 ``` ┌───────────────┐ ┌────────────────┐ │ apps/web │ │ apps/admin │ │ Vue3 用户端 │ │ Vue3 管理端 │ └──────┬────────┘ └───────┬────────┘ │ HTTP (REST) │ └─────────┬──────────┘ ▼ ┌─────────────────────┐ │ services/api │ │ FastAPI 业务面 │ │ 认证 / 编排 / 知识库 │ │ 技能 / 配额 / 审计 │ └─────┬─────────┬─────┘ │ │ model gateway tool gateway ← 双网关（HMAC 签名回调） │ │ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │ services/kernel-host │ │ Node.js DSH 执行面 │ │ Runtime Profile 内容寻址│ │ 回合循环 / 工具桥 / 审验 │ │ 审批 / 事件日志 │ └───────────┬─────────────┘ │ 本地 Agent 配对 ▼ ┌────────────────┐ │ 本地 Agent │ │ CLI + Chromium │ └────────────────┘ ``` ## 核心特性 - **回合制 Agent 编排** — 管理面下发任务，执行面按回合循环驱动模型与工具，状态可恢复 - **知识库检索** — 全文检索起步，可扩展嵌入与重排 - **技能注入** — 技能以 Runtime Profile 内容寻址方式进入 Agent 上下文 - **审批 broker** — 敏感工具调用经人工审批后执行 - **事件日志全链路** — 每个回合、每次工具调用均可追溯 - **白标 / 品牌化** — 展示层品牌（名称 / logo / 主题色）按部署配置，与契约层隔离 - **本地 Agent 配对** — CLI + 独立 Chromium 的本地执行，适配内网无 API 的存量系统 ## 快速开始 ### 前置依赖 - Python >= 3.11（主服务） - Node.js >= 22（内核宿主与前端构建） - MongoDB 与 Redis（本地开发可用 `make mongo-up` / `make redis-up` 拉起，或使用系统安装的实例） ### 启动步骤 ```bash # 1. 生成 .env 密钥（JWT、双网关签名、签名 URL 等） make bootstrap # 2. 编辑 .env，配置 OpenAI 兼容模型服务： # MODEL_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=... # MODEL_PROVIDER_API_KEY=... # MODEL_PROVIDER_MODEL=... # 3. 初始化数据库（索引 + 种子账号 + 服务端工具目录，幂等可重复执行） make mongo-up make redis-up make init-db # 4. 一键启动全部服务（api / kernel / web + mongo / redis） make dev ``` > 说明：数据库初始化也可以跳过（API 首次启动时会自动完成同样的初始化，全部幂等）；`make init-db` 的价值是**启动前显式完成并可查看初始化结果**（打印种子账号写入数、集合文档数）。本地运行数据（Mongo 数据文件、`data/`、`.localdata/`）不进仓库，git 跟踪列表只含源码与文档。 启动后访问 **http://127.0.0.1:4173**（用户端）。各服务端口：主服务 API `127.0.0.1:8000`、内核宿主 `127.0.0.1:8101`、用户端 `127.0.0.1:4173`。 停止服务：`make down`；查看日志：`make logs`。 ### 种子账号 首次启动且用户集合为空时，自动创建三个演示账号（用户名固定，**密码由环境变量注入、不落代码**）： | 用户名 | 角色 | 密码变量 | |---|---|---| | `admin` | 管理员 | `SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | | `ops` | 运维（受限管理） | `SEED_OPS_PASSWORD` | | `member` | 普通成员 | `SEED_MEMBER_PASSWORD` | 首次部署前在 `.env` 中配置这三个密码；生产部署务必修改或删除这些账号。 ### 配置说明 - 全部环境变量模板见 [.env.example](.env.example)，每个变量均带注释说明用途与默认值。 - JWT、双网关签名等密钥由 `deploy/bootstrap/generate-secrets.sh` 自动生成（`make bootstrap` 调用），请勿手工编造、勿入库。 ## 项目结构 ``` ZY-Agents/ ├── services/api/ # FastAPI 主服务（业务面：认证、编排、知识库、技能、双网关） ├── services/kernel-host/ # Node.js 22 DSH 内核宿主（执行面：回合循环、工具桥、审批、事件日志） ├── apps/web/ # Vue3 用户端 ├── apps/admin/ # Vue3 管理端 ├── deploy/ # 部署脚本与密钥生成 ├── docs/ # 设计文档（六份） └── Makefile # 本地开发入口（bootstrap / dev / check 等） ``` ## 文档索引 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [00-architecture-spec.md](docs/00-architecture-spec.md) | 架构规格：约束与结论、部署形态、服务分层、双网关、升级机制 | | [01-engineering-design.md](docs/01-engineering-design.md) | 工程设计：目录树、分层依赖规则、模块接口、装配与编排 | | [02-data-model-and-api.md](docs/02-data-model-and-api.md) | 数据模型与 API：MongoDB 集合字段、公开 HTTP 路由表 | | [03-kernel-contract.md](docs/03-kernel-contract.md) | 内核契约：双网关端点与签名方案、宿主协议、版本锁 | | [04-localagent-protocol.md](docs/04-localagent-protocol.md) | 本地 Agent 协议：配对流程、帧级字段、连接状态机 | | [05-spec-compliance.md](docs/05-spec-compliance.md) | 合规登记：约束落点与检测手段 | ## 社区讨论 欢迎扫码加入微信群「dsh 企业应用开发技术」，一起交流企业级 Agent 平台架构、DSH 内核与本地工具执行的落地实践：

## License [MIT](LICENSE) © ZY-Agents Contributors

plugins.description: DSH ZCode UI — 把 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面换成 ZCode 风格：侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航。A ZCode-styled sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation skin for DSH Web.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ZCode UI **A ZCode-style visual skin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web — sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, turn navigation** [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) [![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH Web Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Web-Plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui) [![Node.js 22 or later](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22%20or%20later-339933.svg?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org/)
> [!IMPORTANT] > **This is a personal, community-maintained project. It carries no official endorsement.** > It is **not** a DeepSeek AI product, and it is **not** an official plugin of any kind — it is maintained by one individual (`jungenius-stack`) in their own time. > It is a fork of the open-source project [MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) (Apache-2.0), and its design values are taken from [zai-org/ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode) (Apache-2.0). > "DeepSeek", "DeepSeek Harness" and "ZCode" are the property of their respective owners; the names are used here only to describe compatibility and design provenance. > [!WARNING] > **Beta — this is an early test build.** The interface and behaviour still change quickly, and the rough edges are listed openly in [`docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md`](docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md). > **Corrections and improvement suggestions are genuinely welcome** — please open an [issue](https://github.com/jungenius-stack/dsh-zcode-ui/issues). The most useful report is short: what you expected, what happened, and a screenshot if the problem is visual. DSH ZCode UI repaints the DSH Web interface in ZCode's (Zhipu / Zai) visual language: the sidebar, the workspace session tree, the header search, and the composer all adopt ZCode geometry, palette, and iconography — in both light and dark themes. **The skin itself changes nothing else.** Everything it draws flows through DSH's own `SlotRegistry` slots and `ctx` public services, and it never writes conversation records. One thing worth stating plainly, because the paragraph above used to overstate it: this package is a fork of [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui) and **also carries upstream's non-visual features** — a dependency panel that can run `pnpm` and rewrite `node_modules`, session moves between workspaces, and "open in file manager". They are inherited rather than written here, and they are what the About page exposes. You can simply not use them, but they do ship in this package. See [Scope and permissions](#scope-and-permissions). ## What you get | Area | What the skin does | | --- | --- | | **Layout** | ZCode sidebar geometry — 8px radii, 32px rows, `px-2 / py-3 / gap-1` spacing, 150–200ms `ease-out` motion, seven-step type scale | | **Colour** | Full Zai Light / Zai Dark palettes written into DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer; official regions (title bar, session list, buttons, menus, composer shell) recolour as one piece | | **Icons** | Lucide (the same icon library ZCode uses) for sidebar navigation and row actions | | **Theme** | Follows the host's own light/dark preference via `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`; light canvas `#f8f8f8`, dark canvas `#161616` | | **Sidebar behaviour** | Pin / group / drag-reorder projects and conversations, unread and running indicators, header search over sessions + settings + quick actions, rename / archive / fork / copy / delete, turn navigation in long conversations, Up/Down recall of previous input | ## Screenshots The two images at the top of this page are the light and dark sidebar + workspace tree. A few more views. > Project names, conversation titles and the balance figures in every screenshot are **demo data** — the > captures are sanitised before committing so no real workspace ever appears in this repository. > > **Re-captured for 1.15.0** (2026-10-18) against a live host (`0.2.1-rc.2`) in an isolated profile, > so the session indent, monochrome card icons and wider group spacing shown here are the real thing. > Demo data only — no real workspace appears in this repository. Settings page — selected states are neutral, matching the sidebar (no blue leftovers from the host defaults): ![Settings page, light theme](assets/screenshots/settings-light.png) Header search across conversations and settings: ![Header search, light theme](assets/screenshots/search-light.png) Collapsed rail — icon-only, with tooltips on hover: ![Collapsed rail, light theme](assets/screenshots/collapsed-light.png) ## How it differs from upstream This fork keeps upstream's interaction scaffolding and data layer, and adds: - **The ZCode skin itself** — 174 `--dsw-*` tokens per theme (light and dark) plus 23 structural tokens, 197 unique token names in total. Every token consumed anywhere in `src/` is covered by the maps; the `token-coverage` assertion fails the build if that ever stops being true. - **Theme single-source-of-truth** — the host attribute is the only signal. No `prefers-color-scheme` fallback, which used to split the sidebar and the content area when the host was light but the OS was dark. - **Fixes found by looking at the real interface**, not by reading code: session hover card trimmed to the title only, send button rendered in the real primary colour (`--dcu-primary` is now defined at `:root` so the composer — which lives outside `.dcu-root` — can resolve it), a "back to conversation" entry when a global panel is open, self-drawn sidebar separator lines removed, marquee title clipping, footer separation, and shorter empty-state cards. - **A verification stack that actually runs on this machine** — see [Verification](#verification). Upstream's browser-based layout scripts had never been executed here before (the Chromium binary was missing), which is how five stale assertions stayed hidden. ## Scope and permissions A skin should not need a permissions conversation. This one does, because it is a fork and inherited more than visuals. Being explicit is cheaper than being trusted by accident. | Capability | Reachable from | Touches | | --- | --- | --- | | Recolour the UI | always, on install | DSH's `--dsw-*` token layer and this plugin's own stylesheets. No data. | | Sidebar / session tree / search | always, on install | Renders through official slots. Reads session and workspace lists; never writes conversation records. | | Dependency panel | the About page, on click | Runs `pnpm`, rewrites `node_modules` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` in the active workspace. | | Move session to workspace | the session context menu | Rewrites that session's artifact files. | | Open in file manager | file path menus | Opens the OS file manager. Read-only. | | Five REST endpoints | the plugin's own UI only | Serves the four features above; authenticated per session. | Everything in the lower four rows is **inherited from [`dsh-codex-ui`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui)** and is also exposed on the About page inside DSH. If you only want the skin, nothing here runs unless you click it. ## Requirements - A working **DeepSeek Harness Web** installation with `dsh` on your `PATH`. Examples below use the `web` profile; substitute your own profile name. - **Host compatibility.** Peer dependencies declare the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` range `>=0.1.6-alpha.2 <0.3.0-0`; development is pinned to `0.2.0-rc.2`. The heavy gate (`pnpm gate:host`) packs the plugin, installs it into an isolated `DSH_HOME`, and exercises the real `dsh` binary found on the machine — override it with `DCU_DSH_BIN`. - **Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`** if you build from source. - ⚠️ On macOS, do **not** put DSH's bundled Node 24 first on `PATH` when building or testing: it cannot load the `rolldown` native binding (`code signature ... different Team IDs`) and `vitest` / `tsdown` will fail.

plugins.description: Drive the open-source ArtCraft studio apps — PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft... — from DeepSeek Harness, in chat or from your own UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# ArtCraft Bridge **Drive the open-source ArtCraft studio apps — PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft — from DeepSeek Harness, in chat or from your own UI.** [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) `@ninkch/dsh-artcraft` · a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin · Apache-2.0
--- ## Why this exists [ArtCraft](https://getartcraft.com/apps) is a family of **thirteen** free, fair-source reinventions of Adobe's studio tools, written from scratch in pure Rust: **PhotoCraft** (Photoshop), **VectorCraft** (Illustrator), **FilmCraft** (Premiere Pro), **LightCraft** (Lightroom), **PdfCraft** (Acrobat), **EffectCraft** (After Effects), **DesignCraft** (InDesign), **WordCraft** (Word), **DeckCraft** (PowerPoint), **GridCraft** (Excel), **CADCraft** (AutoCAD), **SoundCraft** (Pro Tools) and **FigCraft** (Figma). They share one superpower that most desktop apps don't have: **every menu item, slider and dialog is a command**, and the exact same commands can be driven from a headless CLI, a JSON control channel, or an MCP server. The apps were built for agents from day one. This plugin brings that surface into DeepSeek Harness, so an AI agent can *operate* the apps — not just talk about them: - **In chat** — nine agent tools let any Harness session check the toolchain, run CLI commands, send control-channel commands to a running app, do bridged file operations, run delivery QC, and consult a per-app capability catalog. - **A bundled craft skill pack** — eleven skills (`artcraft-ops`, `artcraft-shot-language`, `artcraft-edit-rhythm`, `artcraft-color-light`, `artcraft-sound-design`, `artcraft-motion-vfx`, `artcraft-delivery-qc`, `artcraft-style-bible`, `artcraft-film-study`, `artcraft-batch-pipeline`, `artcraft-multicam`) teach the agent *how* to drive the suite fluently, which effect to reach for, how to design shot language, pacing, grade and sound, how to lock a consistent look across episodes, how to break a film down into evidence, how to run batches, and how to cut multicam. They ship inside the plugin and load on demand (English index: `skills/README.md`). - **In the browser** — a same-origin HTTP API (`/artcraft/api/*`) that any Harness web UI can call, no CORS, no keys. It was built for [无限画布 / infinite-canvas](../dsh-infinite_canvas/README.md), a node-based AI short-drama storyboard canvas, but any front end can use it. - **Paths belong to the caller** — this plugin is a bridge and owns no data directory. Files read or written go wherever the caller points: chat invocations default to the current conversation workspace (or any path named in the prompt); the canvas writes under its own project folder. - **Paths belong to the caller** — this plugin is a bridge and owns no data directory. Files read or written go wherever the caller points: chat invocations default to the current conversation workspace (or any path named in the prompt); the canvas writes under its own project folder. A typical AI short-drama loop looks like this: generate storyboard frames with a model → batch color-grade and sharpen them in PhotoCraft → render an animated title in EffectCraft → assemble the final cut in FilmCraft with grading, mixing and burned-in subtitles → export H.264. Every step after "generate" runs through this plugin, headless. ## How it fits together ``` ┌──────────────── DeepSeek Harness web UI (browser) ────────────────┐ │ e.g. infinite-canvas: ① upload assets ② start jobs ③ fetch │ └─────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘ ▼ same-origin fetch, no CORS ┌──────────────── DSH Host · @ninkch/dsh-artcraft ────────────────┐ │ HTTP routes /artcraft/api/* + agent tools artcraft_* │ │ → child processes (the CLIs) → TCP control channel │ └──────┬───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┬───────────┘ ▼ ▼ ▼ photocraft-cli filmcraft-cli effectcraft-cli batch grading, PSD EDL/XML in-out, .ecproj (JSON) render, headless edits cut · grade · mix Lottie export └───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘ ▼ caller-decided locations (chat → conversation workspace · canvas → its project folder) ``` Everything runs locally. No cloud round-trips, no accounts, no telemetry. ## Requirements - **DeepSeek Harness** (desktop), any platform the Harness supports. - **ArtCraft apps** — grab what you need from [getartcraft.com](https://getartcraft.com/apps) or the [storytold GitHub releases](https://github.com/storytold). The portable/installer builds ship the CLI binaries on Windows and Linux (`photocraft-cli.exe` …); macOS ships them as a separate notarized zip. Versions tested: PhotoCraft 0.6, FilmCraft 0.5, EffectCraft (early). - Nothing else. No Python, no FFmpeg — the ArtCraft apps bring their own codecs. ## Setup **1. Get the plugin onto disk** (this repository). Any folder works; keeping it inside the Harness workspace next to your other local plugins is the convention. **2. Register it with your Harness profile.** A Harness profile is a pnpm package at `C:\Users\\.dsh\profiles\\` (desktop profile by default). Two edits: ```jsonc // package.json in the profile { "dependencies": { // ...existing deps... "@ninkch/dsh-artcraft": "^0.1.1", // ← from npm // or, for local development, a link into this repository: // "@ninkch/dsh-artcraft": "link:D:/code/deepseek-plugin/dsh-artcraft" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // ...existing bundles... "@ninkch/dsh-artcraft" // ← add the name ] } } } ``` Then link and restart the Harness once (Host-side code loads at startup): ```sh pnpm install --dir C:/Users//.dsh/profiles/desktop ``` > If your Harness build ships a plugin manager UI that installs from a folder, that works too — > it ends up writing exactly the two lines above. **3. Configure** `artcraft.config.json` (copy from `artcraft.config.json.example`). Recommended location: `C:\Users\\.dsh\artcraft.config.json` (persists across plugin updates); placing it next to `index.js` also works (legacy). The file is re-read on every request — no restart needed for path changes: ```jsonc { "bins": { // three accepted forms: a directory (the -cli binary is appended), // a full path to the executable, or a bare name looked up on PATH "photocraft": "C:/craft/photocraft-0.6.0-windows-x64-portable", "filmcraft": "C:/craft/filmcraft-0.5.0-windows-x64-portable", "effectcraft": "C:/Program Files/EffectCraft" }, "control": { "filmcraft": 9876, "effectcraft": 9877 } } ``` **4. Verify.** In any Harness chat, ask your agent to run `artcraft_status`. Green lights across `bins.*.found` and you're done. ## Driving it from chat The plugin registers four tools. The agent composes them, so plain language works: > *"Color-grade every PNG in `demo/media` with a soft S-curve and smart sharpening at 80, put the > results in `demo/out/graded`."* Behind that sentence the agent will typically do: ``` artcraft_cli { bin:"photocraft", args:["batch","--actions","demo/craft/grade.json", "--in","demo/media","--out","demo/out/graded"] } ``` | Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `artcraft_status` | Toolchain health check: which of the 12 CLIs resolved, config location, control ports, running jobs | | `artcraft_cli` | Run any CLI subcommand synchronously (`photocraft-cli run/batch`, `wordcraft-cli convert`, …) | | `artcraft_control` | One command over the JSON control channel of a *running* app (filmcraft 9876 / effectcraft 9877 / vectorcraft 7979 / lightcraft 7980, or pass `port`) | | `artcraft_fs` | Bridged file ops — list / stat / read / write / mkdir at caller-decided absolute paths | | `artcraft_discover` | Family install auto-discovery: fills missing paths, auto-corrects stale ones | | `artcraft_apps` | Capability catalog for

plugins.description: 🗃️ 为 DSH 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具通过 activate_tools 按需加载。| Load only basic DSH tools by default, and activate the rest on demand via activate_tools.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-tool-activator [![npm version][npm-version-src]][npm-version-href] [![npm downloads][npm-downloads-src]][npm-downloads-href] [![bundle][bundle-src]][bundle-href] [![JSDocs][jsdocs-src]][jsdocs-href] [![License][license-src]][license-href] 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 减少初始工具上下文：默认仅展示基础工具，其余工具通过 `activate_tools` 按需加载。 * **系统要求**：DSH $\ge$ `0.2.0-rc.2`；Node.js $\ge$ `22.19.0`。 --- ## 核心行为 默认基础工具为 `read`、`glob`、`grep`、`write`、`edit`、`skill`、`ask_user_question`、`todo_write`，均可取消默认加载；只有 `activate_tools` 始终加载且不可关闭。 模型每次都看到：配置为默认加载的工具、已激活工具、`activate_tools`，以及其余工具的 `` 简述目录。 ### 默认启用的工具 `read`、`glob`、`grep`、`write`、`edit`、`skill`、`ask_user_question`、`todo_write` ### 可通过 `activate_tools` 加载的工具 其余已安装且在当前 agent 作用域可见的工具默认隐藏，由模型按标识激活。常见内置工具： | 分类 | 工具标识 | | --- | --- | | 文件写入 | `write`、`edit` | | 命令执行 | `bash`、`pwsh` | | 联网 | `web_search`、`web_fetch` | | 后台任务 | `job_output`、`job_list`、`job_kill` | | 终端 | `terminal_open`、`terminal_send`、`terminal_read`、`terminal_signal`、`terminal_close`、`terminal_list` | | 目标 | `get_goal`、`create_goal`、`update_goal` | | 会话检索 | `session_search`、`session_event_search`、`session_trace`、`session_event_trace`、`session_event_read` | | 代码智能 | `lsp` | | 编排 | `subagent`、`subagent_fork`、`workflow`、`ralph`、`structured_output` | 此外，任意已安装插件的工具都可作为标识请求；开启 `autoGroupMcp` 时，`mcp__server__tool` 还会按 server 聚合为 `mcp.server`。 实际可用集合将以 `` 目录呈现，该目录随提示词注入给模型，只有标识、名称和一句简述： ```xml Search the public web for current information. send: Send a message through the mailbox. ``` 模型可按需请求加载工具或组： ```json { "identifiers": ["web_search", "web_fetch"], "reason": "需要检索并核对用户要求的公开资料" } ``` --- ## 配置 进入官方插件管理页，打开 `dsh-tool-activator` 卡片，配置表单直接显示在该插件的页面上。 表单显示工具列表： | 分区 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | **默认激活** | 每次请求都带完整 schema 的工具；基础工具排在最前并带"基础工具"标记，但允许关闭；仅 `activate_tools` 的开关固定开启且不可关闭 | | **按需激活** | 其余工具，模型可使用 `activate_tools` 按需获取 | 打开某一项的开关即把它写进 `basicTools`（默认加载），关闭则移回按需区；工具清单与描述由宿主 Remote `toolActivator/catalog` 提供，覆盖当前所有 live agent 作用域。 **常规**区两个开关：`requireApproval`（非完全权限时激活前请求确认，缺少审批服务时直接拒绝；完全权限 `danger-full-access` 时无需确认，即使审批策略为 `never`）与 `autoGroupMcp`（按 `mcp__server__tool` 前缀聚合同一 MCP 服务） **工具分组**区是结构化编辑器：每个分组有标识符、名称、说明、工具勾选（只能从当前目录里的真实工具中选）和说明节绑定，支持增删；留空则每个工具各自成为条目。`sectionTools` 仍留在 schema 里（进阶用法：说明节到工具名的依赖映射），但不再出现在表单中。 --- ## 状态、审批与生命周期 * **执行路由**：通过 DSH 原有 dispatcher 执行，不改变底层沙箱或运行路由。 * **持久化与恢复**：已完成的激活状态随标准会话日志和 seed 恢复，不依赖中途内存状态。 * **生命周期**：Cordis 负责注册、监听及 HMR 清理，卸载时自动清理样式与实例。 --- * **测试情况**：2026-10-11 完全权限修复后，12 个文件、304 个用例全部通过；lint、类型检查与 Build 同样通过。 * **未验证项**：真实 GUI E2E、打包发布及真实 profile 验证。 --- ## 许可证 MIT 第三方声明见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md]()。 [npm-version-src]: https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-tool-activator?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669 [npm-version-href]: https://npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-activator [npm-downloads-src]: https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-tool-activator?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669 [npm-downloads-href]: https://npmjs.com/package/dsh-tool-activator [bundle-src]: https://img.shields.io/bundlephobia/minzip/dsh-tool-activator?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669&label=minzip [bundle-href]: https://bundlephobia.com/result?p=dsh-tool-activator [jsdocs-src]: https://img.shields.io/badge/jsdocs-reference-080f12?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669 [jsdocs-href]: https://www.jsdocs.io/package/dsh-tool-activator [license-src]: https://img.shields.io/github/license/hairyf/dsh-tool-activator.svg?style=flat&colorA=080f12&colorB=1fa669 [license-href]: https://github.com/hairyf/dsh-tool-activator/blob/main/LICENSE.md ##
